title: Course pack: course.json
description: The top of a course pack in src/packs/courses/<from>-<to>/: which languages it pairs and how its units group into sections. Each unit lives in units/<unitId>.json.

formatVersion.description: Version of the pack file format. The app upgrades older formats when it loads them.

version.description: Content version. Raise it whenever an id is renamed or removed, and add a migration so saved progress follows.

from.description: Base language: the one the learner already reads. A code from languages.json.

to.description: Target language: the one being taught. A code from languages.json.

status.description: draft until a fluent speaker has reviewed the whole course.

title.description: In the base language, e.g. "Luganda for English speakers".

description.description: One or two sentences, in the base language, about the target language and where it is spoken.

notes.description: For authors and reviewers; never shown to learners.

sections.description: Stages of the course, in order. Units appear in the order listed here.

units.description: Unit ids. A listed unit with no file yet is skipped, so content can land a few units at a time.
